channel.title: Employee Benefit News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Employee Benefit News (benefitnews.com)

item.title: AI can make workplaces safer by improving misconduct reporting process
item.description: More than half of instances of harassment, discrimination and violence are going unaddressed, but technology is bridging the gap.

item.title: Advisers are the new go-to source for estate planning — here's why
item.description: Some 80% of respondents said they expect estate planning to be integrated into financial wellness offerings.

item.title: $1 trillion lost as workers delay mental health care
item.description: A nationwide survey finds 41% of workers say mental health or substance use issues affected their jobs, costing more than $1 trillion over five years.

item.title: Help employees practice self love with benefits
item.description: From physical wellness to financial stability, workers feel and perform better when they use impactful employer offerings.

item.title: A welcomed turning point for earned wage access
item.description: Clarifying that accessing earned wages through employer-integrated models is not the same as borrowing removes a major obstacle to adoption.

item.title: How to close America's growing retirement divide
item.description: Dayforce's global head of sustainability and impact shares multiple ways for employers to help workers reverse negative retirement trends.

item.title: The fall of personalization and rise of anticipatory benefits
item.description: To stay competitive leaders are going to have to anticipate employees' needs before they arise.

item.title: Endless meetings and apps leave employees struggling to focus
item.description: A surge in meetings and constant digital notifications has left employees with minimal time for deep, uninterrupted focus on their work.

item.title: 3 issues shaping the future of retirement planning: Morningstar
item.description: The focus of retirement planning is shifting, according to Morningstar experts, moving away from simple saving toward bespoke decumulation strategies and guaranteed lifetime income solutions.

item.title: Pinterest and Maven team up to provide menopause support to employees
item.description: Pinterest's CPO Doniel Sutton explains the decision to bring in a holistic family-building and women's health platform that includes this important life stage.
